author: aditsangani
summary: Bound consumer capture age with correlated clocks and original frame lineage
details: Add a stateful final-consumer freshness gate and certificate-verified WSS client using the accepted protocol. Bound phone depth/heartbeat through one-time local clock exchanges and justified drift, and vision through the originating Pi's bounded capture ledger. Preserve original deadlines and sequence marks; invalidate unknown, expired, future, replayed or mismatched evidence. Heartbeat and clock resync never renew observations. Relay clocks, shared schemas and baseline budgets remain unchanged.
validation: 57 backend tests passed locally, including 21 freshness cases and actual loopback WSS calibration, fresh-depth eligibility and stale rejection. Legacy HTTP replay passed. Shared repository/contract, scope, structure, rendered log and whitespace checks run through checked publishing. Test drift values are synthetic; no real phone/Pi drift, edge motor integration, electrical or deployed-service acceptance claimed.
